The core operators are grounded in probabilistic snap-reads and threshold-based propositions. Snap-read targeting (R_s, T_t) forms a binary decision space where each player’s viability is assessed via real-time situational awareness. Threshold propositionalization (Y_r, T_h) maps observed performance against predefined limits, generating binary outcomes with associated confidence (C_c). The performance confidence vector (V_p, C_c) extends this into multi-dimensional player evaluation, where each metric contributes to a composite belief. Dualities emerge between GSI's Bayesian updating and GSE's state transitions—both rely on empirical signals to refine predictions. Failure modes include misalignment of R_s with actual game flow, invalidation of T_h due to rule changes, and collapse of V_p under low-confidence scenarios. These operators form a closed-loop system where telemetry feeds back into belief refinement.
